entry.content: Investigating virtual machine (VM) incidents, such as Microsoft Windows kernel panics ("Blue screen of death", or BSOD for short) or I/O hangs, traditionally required running a cluster-wide must-gather combined with sosreport , which could potentially take hours to run. entry.title: Determining Whether an Application Has Poor Cache Performance
entry.content: Modern computer systems include cache memory to hide the higher latency and lower bandwidth of RAM memory from the processor. The cache has access latencies ranging from a few processor cycles to 10 or 20 cycles, rather than the hundreds of cycles needed to access RAM. If the processor must frequently obtain data from the RAM rather than the cache, performance will suffer. entry.title: Examining Huge Pages or Transparent Huge Pages Performance
entry.content: All modern processors use page-based mechanisms to translate the user-space processes virtual addresses into physical addresses for RAM.
